privacyPolicy.title: Protect personal data with secure, transparent handling
privacyPolicy.description: TAF Viet is committed to processing personal data lawfully, transparently, and securely in accordance with Vietnam’s personal data protection regulations, including Decree 13/2023/NĐ-CP.

sections.title: 1. Purpose of collecting information
sections.body: TAF Viet collects personal information from customers, website visitors, and service users to receive consultation requests, manage accounts, process records, communicate, and support accounting, tax, HR, and business advisory services.

sections.title: 2. Personal data processed
sections.body: The information collected may include full name, phone number, email, company details, job title, consultation request content, related files, and technical data such as IP address, device information, browser, and access times.

sections.title: 3. Legal basis and processing purpose
sections.body: We process personal data based on consent, contractual obligations, legal requirements, and the protection of legitimate interests of customers and TAF Viet, as well as for management, advisory, and support activities in accordance with Vietnamese law and Decree 13/2023/NĐ-CP on personal data protection.

sections.title: 4. Security and storage
sections.body: Personal data is stored on secure systems with limited access, appropriate encryption, and technical and organizational safeguards. TAF Viet does not share personal data with third parties unless required by law or authorized by the data subject.

privacyPolicy.rightsBody: Customers have the right to request access, correction, deletion, or restriction of personal data processing, and to object to processing when there is a legal basis. If you need assistance or want to file a complaint about personal data, please contact the contact information publicly provided by TAF Viet.
privacyPolicy.contactBody: TAF Viet may update this policy over time to reflect changes in law or internal procedures. Any material change will be announced on the company website. If you have any questions about data security, please contact TAF Viet through the publicly listed support channels.

termsOfUse.title: Rules for using the website and advisory services of TAF Viet
termsOfUse.description: The terms below govern access to and use of the TAF Viet website and its advisory services. We recommend reading them carefully to understand your rights, obligations, and responsibilities.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance and conditions
sections.body: By accessing or using the TAF Viet website, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to the terms of use below. If you do not agree, please stop using the website and do not submit personal data to TAF Viet.

sections.title: 2. Purpose of the website
sections.body: The website is used to provide information about accounting, tax, business advisory services, support materials, professional articles, and contact channels with the TAF Viet team. The content is for preliminary reference only and does not replace legal or specialized accounting advice for each specific case.

sections.title: 3. User responsibilities
sections.body: Users agree not to use the website for unlawful purposes, harming the system, fraud, impersonation, or interfering with website operations. TAF Viet may block, restrict, or refuse access if behavior is deemed inappropriate.

sections.title: 4. Copyright and website content
sections.body: All content on the website, including text, images, layout, forms, logos, and documents, is owned by TAF Viet or lawfully licensed for use. Reproduction, reuse, distribution, or modification is prohibited without written consent from TAF Viet.

termsOfUse.supportBody: TAF Viet may update or revise these terms at any time to reflect business operations or legal requirements. Any questions, requests, or complaints regarding website content, advisory services, or contact information should be sent through the support channels publicly available on the website.

faqs.question: Why does marketplace settlement not equal gross order value?
faqs.answer: Settlement totals may be reduced by platform commissions, advertising fees, promotions, refunds, shipping costs, and other deductions.

faqs.question: Do I need separate records for each sales channel?
faqs.answer: It is useful to keep the source of each revenue stream clear so the business can reconcile payments, refunds and channel-level performance.

faqs.question: Can TAF Viet help with e-invoices and supporting documents?
faqs.answer: Yes. Record organization, invoice review and supporting-document checks can be supported based on the actual operating model.

faqs.question: What if my business is growing and the accounting process is still manual?
faqs.answer: A review of the current process can help identify the best next step, from better organization to stronger reporting and compliance support.
